content.short: Modular Account is an ERC-4337 modular smart contract account that is ERC-6900 compliant.
content.description: Modular Account is an ERC-4337 smart contract-based wallet that supports customizable features via ERC-6900 plugins. The project is production-ready and has undergone multiple security audits. It ships with three prebuilt plugins: Multi-Owner, Session Keys, and a Multisig plugin, enabling flexible control patterns. Modular Account is designed to support any custom account behavior you need, making it adaptable to a wide range of use cases.
